decisive_spans.text: Multiple small capillary malformations on trunk (hyperpigmented)
Revealed vascular malformation with capillary dilation

response.rationale: The patient presents with multiple small capillary malformations on the trunk and a vascular malformation with capillary dilation, which are key features of Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome. While Parkes Weber Syndrome also involves vascular malformations, the specific description of capillary malformations and dilation strongly supports Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
